Downloaded: 2026-09-21
Downloaded by: research task (owner request: free packs for music/SFX for M5)
Original zip: kenney_music-jingles.zip from
  https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/music-jingles/f37e530b9e-1677590399/kenney_music-jingles.zip
Original zip sha256: b729ba57959bd58793d2c5cafa348aaf2655d354f3da35ec4729e03ec77197b8
Format: 85 short .ogg stingers across 5 subfolders (8-Bit jingles, Hit jingles,
  Pizzicato jingles, Sax jingles, Steel jingles) -- each 1-3 seconds, not
  loopable background music.
Covers: short musical stings for discrete moments -- a key found, a mini-game
  won, the box opening. The "8-Bit jingles" subfolder is the closest style
  match to this game's chiptune-ish target sound.
Does not cover: a loopable title-screen or card bed (see
  aureolus-15-melodic-rpg-chiptunes for that).
